'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a hot-headed, female NPC Gladiator located in [[Capitoline Hill City]]. She is seen arguing with her adoptive father, [[Publius|Publius Odle]] or an ex-Gladiator, [[Catalino]]. 

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Day)
:'''Cilania''': I'm not that little crybaby you remember now, Father. The weak girl I once was... is long gone.
:{{DIcon}} Silently watch the girl and her father argue.
::'''Publius''': You are missing the point, Cilania. Yes, trees will grow tall and shoots will grow lush, and one day, my daughter, you'll have a happier life, far from this home. But not yet. Not now. 
::'''Cilania''': I... don't need your protection anymore. I'm strong now. I've grown up. I can stand on my own as a gladiator!
::'''Publius''': No, you don't understand. I swore an oath to the esteemed one in Septimont that as long as I draw breath, I will not let you set foot on that battlefield again.
::'''Publius''': A daughter of the Odle Family is meant to embrace love and family, not clutch a weapon among the dead and dying. Cilania, you don't need to burn so fiercely, like the sun. Why not simply... shine gently as one of Septimont's little stars?
::'''Cilania''': I understand how you feel, but I didn't become a Gladiator to find happiness, Father.
::'''Cilania''': That rainy night, you carried me in your arms and carved a way through the TD Outbreak in the Sanguis Plateaus. To this day, people still talk about how the Odle Family stole an orphan right back from death's grip.
::'''Cilania''': All that we are is forged by our own honor and our victories in battle. The sons and daughters of the Odle Family are born to be as radiant as the sun.
::'''Cilania''': So, I'm not here to argue with you today. Father, I've come to say goodbye.
::'''Cilania''': All because I am your daughter. I want to be your daughter. I am Cilania of the Odle Family. I am Cilania the Gladiator, who bears our honor.
::'''Publius''': No... Cilania, my daughter...
:{{DIcon|Exit}} Leave
----
;(Night)
:'''Cilania:''' Catalino, I challenge you to an Honor Duel!
:{{DIcon|Talk}} Quietly observe.
::'''Catalino:''' Oh come on, young lady, have mercy! Why won't you let go of a washed-up nobody like me?
::'''Catalino:''' If you're itching for a fight, there are plenty of star contenders in this city. Why not go challenge one of them to an all-or-nothing duel?
::'''Cilania:''' You, a Hunting Group hero, now cower before a woman's sword? You've brought shame upon the name of Septimont, Catalino!
::'''Catalino:''' All this talk of heroes and honor... My lady, aren't you one of the few who made it out of that place alive? Don't you get it? Honor means nothing when you face the [[Dark Tide]]. So why rush back just to throw your life away?
::'''Cilania:''' Cut the crap and face me in the duel!
::'''Catalino:''' I'm done with fighting... If you really can't let go of that battle, do it.
::'''Cilania:''' You miserable coward.
:{{DIcon|Exit}} Leave
{{Dialogue End}}
